title: Social Life Simulation for Non-Cognitive Skills Learning
abstract: arXiv:2405.00273v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Non-cognitive skills are crucial for personal and social life well-being, and such skill development can be supported by narrative-based (e.g., storytelling) technologies. While generative AI enables interactive and role-playing storytelling, little is known about how users engage with and perceive the use of AI in social life simulation for non-cognitive skills learning. Additionally, the benefits of AI mentorship on self-reflection awareness and ability in this context remain largely underexplored. To this end, we introduced Simulife++, an interactive platform enabled by a large language model (LLM). The system allows users to act as protagonists, creating stories with one or multiple AI-based characters in diverse social scenarios. In particular, we expanded the Human-AI interaction to a Human-AI-AI collaboration by including a Sage Agent, who acts as a bystander, providing users with some perspectives and guidance on their choice

translated_title: 面向非认知技能学习的社交生活模拟
translated_abstract: 非认知技能对个人和社交生活的幸福感至关重要，此类技能的发展可以借助基于叙事（如讲故事）的技术来支持。尽管生成式AI能够实现互动式和角色扮演式的叙事，但人们对于用户如何参与并感知在非认知技能学习的社交生活模拟中使用AI仍知之甚少。此外，在此背景下，AI导师指导对自我反思意识和能力的益处也在很大程度上未被充分探索。为此，我们推出了Simulife++，一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的交互式平台。该系统允许用户扮演主角，在多样化的社交场景中与一个或多个AI角色共同创作故事。特别地，我们通过引入一个作为旁观者的“贤者智能体”，将人机交互扩展为人-AI-AI协作模式，为用户提供关于其选择的视角和指导。
tldr: 本文提出基于大语言模型的交互式社交生活模拟平台Simulife++，通过引入“贤者智能体”将人机交互创新性地扩展为人-AI-AI协作模式，支持用户在多样化社交场景中培养非认知技能并提升自我反思能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Simulife++, an LLM-powered interactive social life simulation platform that supports non-cognitive skills learning by innovatively expanding human-AI interaction into a Human-AI-AI collaboration through a Sage Agent providing guidance and perspectives.
